subject: SablePoint SIG+SOC2 Evidence Sprint — kickoff and owners
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sablepoint.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + SIG/SOC2 evidence ask and timeline

Hi Marissa / Karthik / Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — SablePoint is moving fast and compliance is the gating item for our security review. Attached is our SIG-style control request (PDF) and a short list of prioritized artifacts we need for next week's architecture review. Top asks:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) + SOC auditor contact
- ISO 27001 certificate (if available) and scope statement
- KMS key inventory and rotation proof (past 12 months)
- Network segmentation diagram for the hosted service + VPC peering notes
- Example audit logs showing read access to customer data (redacted)
- Evidence of deployment pipeline approvals and access controls (PR approvals/audit trail)

We need a first-pass evidence bundle by Tue 2028-05-09 (EOD PT) to feed into our internal risk assessment. Can you confirm owners, and whether any items require an NDA or secure upload? We prefer links to a secure SharePoint or your artifact manifest rather than large email attachments.

Also including Priya Rao (info-sec reviewer) on the thread.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Security Lead, SablePoint Inc.

Attachments: SablePoint_SIG_Control_Request_2028-05-04.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@sablepoint.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@sablepoint.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SIG/SOC2 evidence ask and timeline

Alex / Priya — thanks for the clear list. We're ready to run an evidence sprint and can meet the Tue 2028-05-09 target for a curated packet. Quick notes and owners:

- SOC 2 Type II report & ISO cert: Jonas will share the artifacts and lead the packet assembly.
- KMS rotation / key inventory: Karthik will export key rotation logs and provide the KMS key manifest + rotation schedule.
- Network diagrams & VPC details: I'll pull the architecture diagrams and a short write-up on peering and ingress controls.
- Audit log example & deployment approvals: Karthik will provide redacted examples and the CI/CD approval audit trail.

We'll upload everything to a secure SharePoint folder (link below) and provide an evidence_manifest_v1.pdf listing each file and owner. We do not require a separate NDA for this level of evidence, but if you prefer a specific upload portal we can accommodate.

Proposed cadence:
- Mon 2028-05-08: internal review of assembled artifacts (Redwood)
- Tue 2028-05-09 EOD PT: delivery of first-pass bundle to SablePoint
- Wed 2028-05-10: optional walkthrough call (30 min) to answer clarifying questions

I've attached our initial control-mapping spreadsheet (control-map_SablePoint_v1.xlsx) with a first-pass crosswalk to SIG categories. Jonas / Karthik — please add row-level evidence links and mark anything that requires redaction.

Link (secure): https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/compliance/SablePoint/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: control-map_SablePoint_v1.xlsx (Excel, 42KB), evidence_manifest_v1.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@sablepoint.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@sablepoint.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 May 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SIG/SOC2 evidence ask and timeline

Alex / team — prepping the exports now. A few technical clarifications that will speed delivery:

1) KMS exports: we will provide a key inventory CSV, rotation_event_log.jsonl (redacted), and the KMS policy snapshot. Keys used for customer data are labeled with "prod/rdw-*" in the manifest.

2) Audit logs: we'll include a 7-day sample of access logs (redacted UIDs) showing read-only hits and the corresponding IAM principal names. If you need longer retention evidence, say 30/90 days, let us know and we'll prioritize.

3) Network diagram: we'll include both the high-level VPC diagram and the peering config (region-specific). Note that for Dedicated customers we can provide more granular network CI.

4) SOC 2 artifacts: we will provide the SOC 2 Type II PDF with the auditor name and a signed attestation. If SablePoint requires an SOC letter of reliance, we'll coordinate via our legal team — that takes ~3 business days.

I'll upload the artifacts to Marissa's SharePoint folder by Mon 2028-05-08 16:00 PT.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@sablepoint.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@sablepoint.com>
Date: Mon, 6 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + SIG/SOC2 evidence ask and timeline

Alex / Priya — I've uploaded the SOC 2 Type II (2027-01 through 2027-12) and our ISO 27001 certificate + scope. Also attached a short control narrative where we map Redwood product features to SIG control families (see evidence_manifest_v1.pdf for pointers).

Deliverables uploaded to: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/compliance/SablePoint/Shared%20Documents/
Files:
- redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (PDF, auditor: Sentinel Audit LLP)
- ISO27001_cert_2026-11.pdf (PDF)
- control_mapping_narrative.txt (TXT)
- kms_key_manifest.csv (CSV)
- audit_log_sample_redacted.zip (ZIP, includes read-access samples)
- control-map_SablePoint_v1.xlsx (updated)
- evidence_manifest_v1.pdf (PDF)

If you'd like a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow at 10am PT to go over the SOC/ISO highlights and any gaps in the control mapping, Marissa — please propose a calendar slot and I'll join.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Director, Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
